title: Careers in the field: SOC, pentest, GRC, forensics and AppSec

videos.script: This course has had one IT person doing everything: risk, firewalls, backups, detection, compliance. In a larger organisation, each of those is somebody's whole job. {{one}} This lesson is the map of those jobs. The people who watch and respond. The people who attack, with permission. The people who manage risk and prove it to auditors. The people who investigate after the fact. And the people who make software safe before it ships. {{five}} For each one you will see what a day looks like, which lessons of this course it grew from, and which course in the catalogue teaches it properly. {{courses}} And one rule for the way in, the same rule this course has kept from its first lab. Practise only on systems you own, or have written permission to test. {{rule}}
